parsed.note_claim: The notified $5 billion US arms package to Saudi Arabia is a proposed congressional notification for precision-guided JDAM munitions.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Foreign Military Sales: Congressional Notification Bureau of Political-Military Affairs September 4, 2026 Transmittal #26-35 The U.S. Department of State has made a determination approving a possible Foreign Military Sale to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for purchase of Joint Direct Attack Munitions – Extend Range (JDAM-ER) and related equipment. The estimated total cost is $5.0 billion.
parsed.reason: The page is an official State Department congressional notification for a $5 billion Foreign Military Sale of JDAM-ER munitions to Saudi Arabia, directly substantiating the note's characterization of the package.
